the implementation of an inlet boundary condition that allows to simulate realistic waveforms at the inlet.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the inlet boundary condition for blood flow simulations should be the forward component of a prescribed variable in an absorbent way.
a better representation of the inlet boundary condition in truncated arterial networks is obtained by prescribing the forward component of a measured variable in an absorbing boundary condition.

the inlet boundary condition should not be considered as an isolated problem, but as an integrated part of the model.
